set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
Dash lengths and pattern or hatch spacing are specified in device pixels. At output scale 2 (HiDPI) they shrink by half, and they look different on screen and in export.

Scope
Express dash and hatch geometry in layout units (points or mm), resolved through the same length resolver as strokes. Device-pixel values remain available only as an explicit opt-in.

Acceptance criteria
1. A dashed line and a hatched fill have the same physical size at 1x and 2x (pixel measurement test).
2. SVG and PDF export use the same physical spacing.
3. Existing output is unchanged where the layout unit equals 1 px at 1x (compatibility).
set.title: [Intaglio] Dash patterns and hatch spacing in layout units, not device pixels
